method.normalization: Function indices are resolved by the exact optimized symbol map and diagnostic custom function names. Only token objects in actual (type $N) uses are replaced by SHA-256 of their structural function signature. Independent local/label identifiers are never replaced, including identical $N spellings. Whitespace/comments do not enter normalized body hashes. S-expression structure and all other WAT tokens, constants, locals, branch labels and global/table names remain unchanged.
method.categories: identical = raw body and normalized tokens equal; relocation-only = raw body differs but symbol/type-normalized tokens equal; body-changed = normalized tokens differ (not a proof of semantic inequivalence); added/removed = optimized symbol absent on one side.
method.limits: No workload, performance measurements or new profiles. Historical profile annotations preserve their commit/runtime identities; samples from a different runtime are not fresh hotness evidence. Optimizer symbol matching is exact by name, with no guessed clone correspondence. Structural function-body equality does not recursively prove callee equality. Module/code layout and engine-generated machine code are not measured.
